title: What to expect
lead: You are about to read a set of workplace scenarios and answer the same questions after each one.
bullets: You will see nine short scenarios about working at NextGen.
Please read each scenario carefully before answering the questions.
Each scenario is unique and should be considered independently of the others—do not try to make your answers consistent across scenarios.
After each scenario, you will rate how you would interact with a peer teammate on that task.
You will not be able to go back to a previous scenario once you continue.
